$comment: Properties allowed to go without a failing mutant on record, each with a mandatory reason. `desktop-rust-property-mutant-records` drops an entry on a local run once its property gains a record (or is gone), so this list only shrinks. A new entry needs David's OK. See `scripts/check/checks/DETAILS.md` § Property mutants.

fuzz:image_headers.reason: Third-party decoders only (`image`, `kamadak-exif`) with no Cmdr line between them for a mutant to change, so a panic, OOM, or hang is the finding.

fuzz:pdf.reason: Third-party only (`pdf-extract`), whose panics the app contains, so only an abort, OOM, or hang counts; the one Cmdr line on the path, `parent_chain_ends`, is a copy inside the target.
